title: A number under its band
description: Fitness 0.8 against a band of 0.9: the reading handed to the adapter says a run did four of its routine's five written steps. The adapter wrote the number and both comparison rows; the kernel reads no number and files the finding. The finding rests on the comparison row below the band, which is on the books of this case with both numbers; the comparisons block of this look is in the recorded sequence `numbers`, which takes the same look again.
